card.text: M72 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 16,660 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 72 is a globular cluster in the south west of the southern constellation of Aquarius.

introduction.text: M72 is drawn as 165 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
